# Data and code availability

No external dataset was used. The supplementary Python verifier constructs the finite cubical incidence matrices from definitions and uses exact integer/GF(2) arithmetic. Its JSON certificate and unit tests are distributed with the manuscript. The analytic theorem does not depend on the verifier or on numerical data.

The literature ledger records the search date, query families, included primary sources, and exclusions. A new database search should be run immediately before submission.
